0bbc63c0d24f.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Why? Who are you?" "What are you talking about?" "I said, who the fuck are you?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} grabs him by the shoulders. "You don't remember? Magina guy? I'm {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}! I've known you for, like, twenty years!"
0bbc63c0d24f.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: “Kenapa? Siapa kau?” “Apa kau merepek ni?” “Aku kata, siapa celaka kau ni?” {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} mencekak bahunya. “Kau tak ingat? Lelaki Magina? Aku {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}! Aku dah kenal kau, macam, dua puluh tahun!”

1eceacc77d6b.en: Harry #12, half asleep on his side, wakes up while two others (weak and feeble on purpose) talk behind him
1eceacc77d6b.t: Harry #12, separuh tidur mengiring, terjaga ketika dua orang lain (lemah dan longlai dengan sengaja) bercakap di belakangnya

3789ad7de8a4.en: Harry focuses all his power into his hands, but nothing happens. The tingle in his spine that radiates down through his body is all there, but no flame comes out. Takeo lets out a single, mocking gasp of laughter. "Is that a new CQC?" "Huh?" "Close Quarters Combat. Show me!" Harry looks at his normal-looking hands and concentrates again. Nothing. "I—dunno. Haaa—"
3789ad7de8a4.t: Harry menumpukan seluruh kuasanya ke tangan, tetapi tiada apa berlaku. Rasa geli di tulang belakangnya yang memancar ke seluruh badan ada semuanya, tetapi tiada api keluar. Takeo melepaskan satu ketawa mengejek. “Itu CQC baharu ke?” “Hah?” “Close Quarters Combat. Tunjukkan!” Harry memandang tangannya yang nampak biasa dan menumpukan perhatian lagi. Tiada apa-apa. “Aku—tak tahu. Haaa—”

3871c378fc19.en: Takeo, Severino and a few others carry dead bodies wrapped in ice crystals, plus a large Bagarisa, as the sun rises
3871c378fc19.t: Takeo, Severino dan beberapa orang lain mengusung mayat berbalut kristal ais, serta seekor Bagarisa besar, ketika matahari terbit

3aa8ab17a5a9.en: Arc #3 - Tasty Lie: the author's story notes (spoilers).
3aa8ab17a5a9.t: Arka #3 - Dusta yang Lazat: nota cerita pengarang (bocoran).

416463ad94bd.en: Severino asks if she has any family left. She doesn't. They invite her to stay and work with them for a while, until she gets back on her feet. Dalila nods; Vitor looks really happy.
416463ad94bd.t: Severino bertanya sama ada dia masih ada keluarga. Tiada. Mereka menjemputnya tinggal dan bekerja dengan mereka buat sementara, sehingga dia bangkit semula. Dalila mengangguk; Vitor nampak sangat gembira.

4bd1eb690337.en: Takeo grabs the two bandits by the hair and turns them toward Harry. "Do you know these two?" Harry shakes his head, straining to see their faces. "I—I—no. I—I don't know them." He keeps his distance. Takeo pulls their heads up to his height. "And you two? Do you know him?" Through their pained groans comes a strong, negative-sounding murmur.
4bd1eb690337.t: Takeo mencekak dua penyamun itu pada rambut dan memalingkan mereka ke arah Harry. “Kau kenal dua orang ni?” Harry menggeleng, bersusah payah melihat muka mereka. “Aku—aku—tak. Aku—aku tak kenal mereka.” Dia menjaga jarak. Takeo menarik kepala mereka ke paras ketinggiannya. “Dan korang berdua? Kenal dia?” Melalui erangan kesakitan mereka kedengaran gumaman kuat yang berbunyi seperti tidak.

66e1adffba40.en: Severino: "Do you really need to take her finger off? Can't you just suck on it, like the others?" "Yes. Now give me your hand, and I'll make it quick." Severino covers his son's eyes, and Nailah looks away. Dalila holds out her hand.
66e1adffba40.t: Severino: “Perlu ke kau cabut jari dia? Tak boleh hisap saja, macam yang lain?” “Perlu. Sekarang bagi tangan kau, dan aku buat cepat.” Severino menutup mata anaknya, dan Nailah memandang ke arah lain. Dalila menghulurkan tangannya.

80ff57c4c6c9.en: Takeo: "I get the whole picture now. This Hifuna beast in Bagarisa form attacked your wagon, then went to the Black Magina farm, where it exploded. Hold out your hand." He takes out pliers, already blood-stained. Dalila looks unsure.
80ff57c4c6c9.t: Takeo: “Aku dah faham gambaran penuhnya sekarang. Hifuna beast dalam bentuk Bagarisa ni serang gerabak kau, kemudian pergi ke ladang Black Magina, tempat ia meletup. Hulurkan tangan kau.” Dia mengeluarkan playar, sudah bernoda darah. Dalila nampak tidak pasti.

8b2cdb4f0f0d.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Who the fuck are you? What are you doing to us?" Takeo locks the door. "Let's talk." He looks at the clicking steel pliers and goes to hit him, but he's too weak: Takeo punches him aside, and he hits the wall and falls to the floor, his head bleeding. {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} hesitates to strike back, but Takeo lands a blow to his face that sends him flying toward Harry.
8b2cdb4f0f0d.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: “Siapa celaka kau? Apa kau buat pada kami?” Takeo mengunci pintu. “Jom berbincang.” Dia memandang playar keluli yang berdetik dan hendak memukulnya, tetapi dia terlalu lemah: Takeo menumbuknya ke tepi, dan dia menghentam dinding dan jatuh ke lantai, kepalanya berdarah. {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} teragak-agak hendak membalas, tetapi Takeo melepaskan pukulan ke mukanya yang menghantarnya terbang ke arah Harry.

92cadf7c2047.en: Panic races through Harry's heart. He looks at his hands and feels a sense of power overwhelming him. In one swift move, he's out of bed and tumbling to the back of the room, putting distance between himself and this monstrous figure. Takeo smiles and clicks his pliers, and the room goes silent.
92cadf7c2047.t: Panik berlumba dalam hati Harry. Dia memandang tangannya dan merasakan kuasa menguasainya. Dengan satu gerakan pantas, dia keluar dari katil dan bergolek ke belakang bilik, menjarakkan dirinya daripada susuk mengerikan ini. Takeo tersenyum dan mendetikkan playarnya, dan bilik itu sunyi.

99182d961248.en: Vitor breaks through his shyness, walks up to Dalila and pats her head. Dalila, eyes red, sniffles as she looks at the flushed boy staring at her.
99182d961248.t: Vitor mengatasi rasa malunya, berjalan ke arah Dalila dan mengusap kepalanya. Dalila, mata merah, teresak-esak ketika memandang budak lelaki yang tersipu-sipu merenungnya.

9b6b9542c32f.en: Takeo snaps off her ring finger and pops it in his mouth, savoring it like a French person savors wine, rolling the chewed finger from one side of his tongue to the other. "Mostly Tolerideme, with some Wozefaries. You're good." Dalila tears up as her finger grows back. Takeo heads for the door. "I'm gonna check a few more."
9b6b9542c32f.t: Takeo mematahkan jari manisnya dan memasukkannya ke dalam mulut, menikmatinya seperti orang Perancis menikmati wain, menggolek jari yang dikunyah dari satu sisi lidahnya ke sisi yang lain. “Kebanyakannya Tolerideme, dengan sedikit Wozefaries. Kau okey.” Dalila bergenang air mata ketika jarinya tumbuh semula. Takeo menuju ke pintu. “Aku nak periksa beberapa lagi.”

ac3e076a1ec4.en: Takeo lets out a big yawn, and the others follow suit. They chat about the world and random stuff.
ac3e076a1ec4.t: Takeo menguap besar, dan yang lain ikut sama. Mereka berbual tentang dunia dan benda-benda rawak.

b10431e80f69.en: The door opens and shuts just as loudly. Harry sits in bed, trying to place all these familiar faces and places; everything is hazy, because his vision is shit.
b10431e80f69.t: Pintu terbuka dan tertutup sama kuatnya. Harry duduk di katil, cuba mengecam semua muka dan tempat yang biasa ini; segalanya kabur, sebab penglihatannya teruk gila.

cf9653a2dec0.en: They come across a broken wagon, broken armor and ragged clothes, with no discernible meat left. One of the men walks a little way into the forest and feels something watery hit his hand. He raises his fost lamp, and another droplet hits him right in the face: a dead girl lies in the tree branches.
cf9653a2dec0.t: Mereka terjumpa gerabak rosak, perisai pecah dan pakaian koyak-rabak, tanpa daging yang kelihatan. Salah seorang lelaki berjalan sedikit ke dalam hutan dan merasakan sesuatu yang berair mengenai tangannya. Dia mengangkat lampu fostnya, dan setitis lagi mengenai mukanya tepat: seorang gadis mati terbaring di dahan pokok.

d4618cc095fa.en: Harry sits up in bed, looking at the door; Takeo has steel pliers ready
d4618cc095fa.t: Harry duduk di katil, memandang pintu; Takeo sedia dengan playar keluli

d5dfcd622553.en: Chapter 1 - The past is the past.

dfa28411ed07.en: Dalila, with Nailah seated beside her, Severino, Vitor (timid, and really likes Dalila) and Takeo
dfa28411ed07.t: Dalila, dengan Nailah duduk di sebelahnya, Severino, Vitor (pemalu, dan sangat suka Dalila) dan Takeo

e52fecee532b.en: Takeo looks back at Harry. "Want to go first or last?" "La—last?" Takeo sets the pliers on {WIP-katsumiBandit}'s fingers. He clips them slowly, savoring the bones breaking, as the man screams in agony. He eats the finger, shakes his head, and spits the half-chewed finger back in the bandit's face.
e52fecee532b.t: Takeo memandang semula Harry. “Nak pergi dulu atau terakhir?” “Te—terakhir?” Takeo meletakkan playar pada jari {WIP-katsumiBandit}. Dia mengepitnya perlahan-lahan, menikmati tulang patah, ketika lelaki itu menjerit kesakitan. Dia makan jari itu, menggeleng, dan meludah jari yang separuh dikunyah kembali ke muka penyamun itu.

ea4f0f0226fe.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit} (the bandit Katsumi killed in Book 7, Chapter 5, now revived): "Hey, do you know where we are?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}: "I have no fucking idea. I just woke up! The door is locked!" He looks around and moves closer. "{WIP-katsumiBandit}, we need to escape through the window!" His worried voice seeps into Harry's ears, waking him.
ea4f0f0226fe.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit} (penyamun yang dibunuh Katsumi dalam Buku 7, Bab 5, kini dihidupkan semula): “Hei, kau tahu kita di mana?” {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}: “Aku langsung tak tahu, celaka. Aku baru bangun! Pintu berkunci!” Dia melihat sekeliling dan bergerak lebih dekat. “{WIP-katsumiBandit}, kita kena lari ikut tingkap!” Suaranya yang risau meresap ke telinga Harry, membangunkannya.

ed3a64ceaa84.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit} slaps his hands away. "You're lying! Touch me again and you'll meet the darkness." {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} grabs his shoulders again, tighter this time, leaning in and raising his voice. "Are you fucking with me? You're not throwing me under the Egua! You're not innocent either! You were the first one abusing them!"
ed3a64ceaa84.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit} menepis tangannya. “Kau tipu! Sentuh aku lagi dan kau akan jumpa kegelapan.” {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} mencekak bahunya lagi, lebih erat kali ini, membongkok dan meninggikan suara. “Kau main-mainkan aku ke? Kau takkan campak aku bawah Egua! Kau pun tak bersih! Kau yang pertama dera mereka!”

f816ec9643fe.en: Author's to-do: after his soul splits, Harry loses the ability to understand anything in the Vraki language, and has to learn everything again from the beginning.
f816ec9643fe.t: Senarai tugas pengarang: selepas jiwanya terbelah, Harry hilang keupayaan memahami apa-apa dalam bahasa Vraki, dan perlu belajar segalanya semula dari awal.
